svg.title: InspectIQ system map, mobile layout
svg.desc: A mobile reading layout of InspectIQ's capture, application authorization, private evidence upload, asynchronous AI suggestion, human review, report release, authoritative Neon records, operational projection, and read-only public walkthrough boundary.

text.tspan: From guided capture to
a report a buyer can trust.
Live AWS-backed · public walkthrough
Review actions stay in the browser session.

svg.text: THE OPERATING PATH · TOP TO BOTTOM

text.tspan: Required-angle photos and offline-aware upload
for web and mobile inspection teams.
Cognito OIDC / PKCE; API Gateway routes to the
Node.js API, which checks JWT and role claims.
Short-lived presigned uploads go directly to S3;
checksums and stable operation IDs aid recovery.
SQS jobs reach a Lambda worker; Bedrock vision
and OCR return schema-checked suggestions.
Compare each suggestion with its photo; accept,
edit, reject, or request a retake.
Confirmed evidence drives grading; unresolved
blockers keep a buyer-visible report from release.
Inspections · evidence references · decisions ·
grades · reports · audit facts
Outbox events support idempotency and operations
state; the projection can be replayed.
GitHub Actions · Terraform AWS IaC · Cloudflare Pages
React web · Expo / React Native mobile
Review actions are session-only; persistent records
remain read-only. API Gateway authorizer enforcement
is not claimed.
